task: Trip readiness review for Vietnam. Write a pre-departure checklist from the supplied records only: the entry requirement and documents to prepare, what to pack for each recorded season, and how to get around with each recorded transit option. One item per record. Where a record is missing or a rule must be confirmed, say to check Smartraveller or the official source.

evidence.title: Vietnam — entry requirement
evidence.text: Records supplied: 1 of 1 weather notes, 1 of 1 transit options. Visa requirement on record: eVisa. Entry notes: Single and multiple entry eVisa applied for online before departure. Carry a printed copy of the approval letter.

evidence.title: Vietnam — weather: Winter (Dec-Feb)
evidence.text: Season: Winter (Dec-Feb). Cool and drizzly in Hanoi and the north while the south stays hot and dry - pack for both climates.

evidence.title: Vietnam — transit: rail
evidence.text: Transit type: rail. The Reunification Express runs Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City. Book soft sleeper berths several days ahead.

plan.objective: Create a pre-departure checklist for Vietnam based on the provided evidence.

steps.description: Gather required documents, including the approval letter for the eVisa.
Pack clothing suitable for both the cool and dry climate of the south and the cool and drizzly climate of the north.
Book a soft sleeper berth on the Reunification Express for the train journey from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City.
Check Smartraveller or the official source for any additional requirements or updates.

success_criteria: The approval letter for the eVisa is present in the traveller's documents.
The traveller has packed clothing suitable for both climates.
The Reunification Express train journey has been booked.
The traveller has checked Smartraveller or the official source for any additional requirements.

human_decision.notes: Accepted i1, i3 and i4. Dropped i2: it leaves out the record's 'south stays hot and dry', so it would pack for the north only. Dropped i5: repeats the rail subject of i3 with no action to take. Also noted: Planner step s2 calls the south 'cool and dry', which the weather-5 record contradicts; no Worker item carried that error.
